UpdateSourceArgs: -lc "set -e; cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; if [ ! -s '{{DatasetName}}.osm.pbf' ]; then curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 -o '{{DatasetName}}.osm.pbf.part' '{{PbfUrl}}'; mv '{{DatasetName}}.osm.pbf.part' '{{DatasetName}}.osm.pbf'; else echo 'PBF already present; skipping download.'; fi"

-lc "set -e; cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; if [ ! -s '{{DatasetName}}.osrm' ]; then /opt/osrm/bin/osrm-extract -p '/opt/osrm/share/osrm/profiles/{{Profile}}.lua' '{{DatasetName}}.osm.pbf'; else echo 'Extracted dataset already present; skipping extract.'; fi"

-lc "set -e; cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; if [ '{{Algorithm}}' = 'mld' ]; then /opt/osrm/bin/osrm-partition '{{DatasetName}}.osrm'; /opt/osrm/bin/osrm-customize '{{DatasetName}}.osrm'; else echo 'MLD preparation skipped.'; fi"
-lc "set -e; cd '{{$FullBaseDir}}'; if [ '{{Algorithm}}' = 'ch' ]; then /opt/osrm/bin/osrm-contract '{{DatasetName}}.osrm'; else echo 'CH preparation skipped.'; fi"
